words.definition: used to signal returning to a previous topic or task after a digression
words.translation: 我們回到……吧（把話題拉回來）
words.example: Let's get back to the budget discussion we started earlier.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們回到剛才開始討論的預算話題吧。
words.note: 常用來把話題拉回正軌，後面接名詞或動名詞，例如 let's get back to work

words.definition: moving repeatedly between two points, opinions, or people; alternating
words.example: We went back and forth on the design for weeks before settling on the final version.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們針對這個設計來來回回討論了好幾週，才敲定最終版本。
words.note: 可當副詞片語，也可當形容詞用（a back-and-forth exchange），常用於討論、爭論或協商的語境

words.definition: to figure out a solution to a problem or reach a satisfactory conclusion through effort
words.example: I'm sure we can work out a schedule that fits everyone's needs.
words.exampleTranslation: 我相信我們可以想出一個符合大家需求的時間表。
words.note: work out 是多義片語：這裡指「解決、想出辦法」；也常表示「運動健身」(I work out every morning) 或「順利發展」(Things worked out fine)，要依上下文判斷語意

words.definition: to have an influence or function in a situation or outcome
words.example: Good communication plays a role in keeping remote teams productive.
words.exampleTranslation: 良好的溝通在維持遠端團隊生產力方面發揮了作用。
words.note: 常見搭配 play a key/important/major role in + N/V-ing，強調在某件事情中所起的作用

words.definition: used to express that one feels unfairly treated or accused
words.translation: 我覺得好委屈；我覺得被冤枉了
words.example: I feel so wronged — I worked overtime all week and still got blamed for missing the deadline.
words.exampleTranslation: 我覺得好委屈——我整週都在加班，結果還是因為錯過截止日期被責怪。
words.note: wronged 是 wrong 的過去分詞當形容詞，表示「受委屈的、被冤枉的」，語氣比較口語、帶情緒

words.definition: to successfully complete or endure a difficult period, task, or communication
words.example: It was a stressful quarter, but the team managed to get through it together.
words.exampleTranslation: 這是個壓力很大的一季，但團隊還是一起撐過去了。
words.note: get through 也常指「打電話聯絡上某人」，例如 I couldn't get through to the office all morning

words.definition: to exhaust oneself physically or emotionally by giving too much effort or energy
words.example: I don't want to drain myself trying to please everyone at work.
words.exampleTranslation: 我不想為了討好職場上的每個人而把自己搞得精疲力盡。
words.note: drain 本意是「排乾、耗盡」，drain oneself 強調把自己的精力或情緒耗盡，也可用被動 be drained（feel drained）

words.definition: to divide something complicated into smaller, simpler parts
words.example: Let's break this project down into smaller tasks so it's easier to manage.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們把這個專案拆解成比較小的任務，這樣比較好管理。
words.note: 常用結構 break A down into B，也可省略受詞說 break it down（拆解一下）

words.definition: to compromise one's own needs, values, or comfort in order to accommodate others
words.translation: 委屈自己；勉強自己遷就別人
words.example: I'm done trying to bend myself to make everyone else happy.
words.exampleTranslation: 我受夠了為了讓每個人都開心而一直委屈自己。
words.note: 強調犧牲自己的原則或需求去配合別人，語氣接近 compromise myself，但更口語、帶委屈的情緒

words.definition: the particular way someone presented or worded an idea, which shapes how it is understood
words.example: I didn't like the plan at first, but how you framed it in the meeting made it much easier to accept.
words.exampleTranslation: 我一開始不喜歡這個計畫，但你在會議上表達的方式讓大家更容易接受。
words.note: 動詞 frame 在此指「用某種方式陳述、包裝一個想法」，相關詞 reframe（重新表述）也很常見

words.definition: used to encourage taking action or trying something, often despite risk or uncertainty
words.translation: 我們放手一搏吧；我們試試看吧
words.example: The offer looks risky, but let's go for it — we might not get this chance again.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個提議看起來有風險，但我們放手一搏吧——我們可能不會再有這樣的機會了。
words.note: go for it 是鼓勵、打氣的常見說法，語氣積極、帶行動力

words.definition: to be in agreement or consistent with something, such as a goal, value, or plan
words.example: Our new marketing strategy needs to align with the company's long-term goals.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們的新行銷策略必須與公司的長期目標一致。
words.note: 常見搭配 align with + N，例如 align with expectations/goals/values

words.definition: to be accepted as part of a group, or to be suitable or compatible within a situation
words.example: It took her a few weeks to fit in with the new team.
words.exampleTranslation: 她花了幾週的時間才融入新團隊。
words.note: fit in with + N 表示融入某個群體；也可不接受詞單獨用，例如 I never really fit in at that school

words.form: I will be here with you
words.definition: used to reassure someone that you will support and accompany them through a difficult situation
words.translation: 我會在你身邊陪著你（表示支持）
words.example: Whatever happens with the diagnosis, I will be here with you every step of the way.
words.exampleTranslation: 不管診斷結果如何，我都會在你身邊陪著你，一路支持你。
words.note: 常搭配 every step of the way 加強語氣，用於安慰、表達支持的情境

words.definition: to examine something more carefully or in more detail
words.example: Before we approve the budget, let's take a closer look at the numbers.
words.exampleTranslation: 在我們核准預算之前，先仔細看看這些數字吧。
words.note: 常接 at + N，例如 take a closer look at the data

words.definition: used to describe an idea or memory suddenly occurring to someone
words.translation: 我突然想到；靈感／回憶突然浮現
words.example: I couldn't remember his name, but then it suddenly came to me.
words.exampleTranslation: 我一時想不起來他的名字，但後來突然想到了。
words.note: 這是固定句型，不能只說裸的 come to me（那通常表示「過來找我」），要用 it came to me 或 an idea came to me

words.definition: to make meaningful progress or create a noticeable impact on a situation
words.translation: 取得實質進展；產生實質影響
words.example: We've tried several strategies, but none of them really moved the needle on customer retention.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們試過好幾種策略，但沒有一個真正對顧客留存率產生實質影響。
words.note: 這是母語者實際使用的標準說法（商業、行銷語境很常見）；你可能會看到 push the needle 這種變體，但那並非標準用法

words.form: we are going to talk about
words.definition: used to introduce the topic that will be discussed next
words.example: Today, we are going to talk about how to improve customer satisfaction.
words.exampleTranslation: 今天，我們要來談談如何提升顧客滿意度。
words.note: 簡報、演講、會議開場常用的句型，後面接名詞或疑問詞子句

words.definition: to stop dealing with one topic or task and start the next one
words.translation: 接著進行；換到下一個（話題／階段）
words.example: Now that we've covered the budget, let's move on to the marketing plan.
words.exampleTranslation: 既然我們已經討論完預算了，接下來就進入行銷計畫吧。
words.note: 常用於會議或簡報中切換話題，後面接 to + N

words.definition: to point out or highlight potential problems or dangers before they become bigger issues
words.translation: 預警風險；提出風險警示
words.example: Part of the analyst's job is to flag risks before they affect the project timeline.
words.exampleTranslation: 分析師的工作之一，就是在風險影響專案時程之前先提出警示。
words.note: flag 在此當動詞，表示「標記、提出警示」，常見於 flag an issue / flag a concern 等用法
